dublinCore.description: Interactive visualization of the course learning graph showing concept dependencies, with taxonomy filtering, type-ahead search and live visible node, visible edge and foundational statistics. Installed from the book-installer viewer template v1.04.

learningObjectives: Identify the prerequisites of a concept by tracing the arrows that point into its node
Use the category checkboxes to isolate one category and predict the node and edge counts before reading them from the statistics
Explain why the edge count jumps when a second category is shown, even though the node count only adds the new concepts
Locate a concept with the search box and state which category it belongs to
Evaluate a study sequence by deciding which categories must be shown together so that every visible concept has all of its prerequisites on the screen

misconceptions.misconception: An arrow points from a concept to the things it needs
misconceptions.correction: In this book's learning graph arrows point from a prerequisite to the concept that depends on it
misconceptions.evidence: Search for Real Numbers: it has no arrow pointing in and 13 arrows leaving it

misconceptions.misconception: Foundational counts the concepts that have no prerequisites
misconceptions.correction: The statistic counts visible concepts with no outgoing arrow. This book's learning-graph.json stores arrows from prerequisite to dependent, so it counts concepts that nothing depends on (112 of 200); only Real Numbers has no prerequisite
misconceptions.evidence: With all categories checked the statistics read Foundational 112, yet Real Numbers is the only node with no arrow pointing in

accessibility.screenReaderScript: Interactive network diagram of the course learning graph. Each node is a concept and each arrow points from a prerequisite to a concept that depends on it. Use the category checkboxes in the sidebar to show or hide a category and the search box to find a concept by name.

visualElements.description: Force-directed network of the learning graph; node color is the taxonomy category, labels appear when zoomed in, and arrows point from prerequisite to dependent concept
Statistics list with the Visible Nodes, Visible Edges and Foundational counts

model.description: Filters a directed graph by node attribute and recomputes the visible node count, the visible edge count (both endpoints visible) and the foundational count (visible nodes with no outgoing arrow)
algorithms: substring search over all node labels
log-scaled node size from the Concept Impact Score (when present)

instructionalStrategies: Prerequisite tracing from a searched concept
Gap analysis: compare a concept's incoming arrows with all categories and with a chosen subset
extensions: Compare with the Learning Graph Viewer V1, which pins foundation and goal nodes
Load a different learning-graph.json to inspect another course
